Commentary.Commentary: Not quite the scoreline Australia would have liked coming on the back of an impressive series win in Sri Lanka. They would have hoped for a lot better performance but it wasn't to be. They will have to travel back home for the Tests against the same side in some time and will hope to move on quickly. South Africa were without their star player in AB de Villiers yet managed to beat Australia convincingly and will be buoyed with their performance in the series. They have whitewashed Australia for the first time and can deservedly party hard. Hope you liked our coverage and we look forward to your company in the coming games. Take care and cheers!

Faf du Plessis reckons that Warner played an incredible knock. Credits his entire team and is proud of the way different individuals have stepped up in the series and performed for the team. Credits Andile Phehlukwayo, Imran Tahir and Kyle Abott for bowling well. Adds that beating the Number 1 team is a dream come true, to beat Australia 5-0 is a great feeling. Mentions that South Africa is going the right way with youngsters putting their hands up. Ends with crediting the players for making most of the chances presented in the series. Hopes that this series win helps them take the momentum to the Tests in Australia.

RILEE ROSSOUW is the MAN OF THE SERIES. He begins stating that he is delighted with his performance. Credits Duminy as well to help him out while batting. Confesses that he only tries to hit the ball as hard as he can and is happy it came off today. Adds that it takes time to adjust to different positions in batting order but is happy to do that for the team. Calls it an emotional moment for him as he is happy that he made most of the opportunities given to him.

DAVID WARNER is the MAN OF THE MATCH. Starts off saying that it was a special effort but is disappointed after not ending on the winning side. Credits South Africa for playing some terrific cricket. Admits that they have got starts in the series but have not nailed them. Says that they have not played to their potential. Hopes to reassess quickly and get better at home.

Steven Smith reckons it was a special performance from David Warner. Adds that the young ones like Mennie, Tremain would have learnt a lot in this tough series. Admits they have been outplayed in the entire series. Adds that he looks forward to being back in Australia and playing domestic games ahead of an exciting summer. Hopes that Starc will be back along with Josh Hazlewood. Admits that they have been disappointing and hopes they improve as a team.

Warner scored a valiant ton but kept losing partners at the other end. Abbott picked up two vital wickets to dismiss Head and then Wade to put South Africa ahead. Warner who was dropped on 11 by Quinton de Kock kept playing his shots to keep Australia in the game all the time. But at the end it was Imran Tahir - the man who affected a brilliant run out to catch Warner short of the crease. Warner departed for a brilliant 173 and once he fell South Africa wrapped up the game quickly and ensured a 5-0 series win with a 31-run victory.

SOUTH AFRICA 5 - AUSTRALIA 0! For the first time in history of One-Day Internationals, Australia have lost all the games in a 5-match ODI series. They were always up against it after conceding a high score of 327. Australia began well in the first Powerplay but once again it was spin that led to their downfall. South Africa came back in the game via Imran Tahir who struck twice in an over to get the hosts back. Australia kept losing wickets but Warner held his head.

OUT! ALL OVER! Back of a length ball around leg stump, Zampa pushes it towards deep mid-wicket and completes a quick single. The throw comes in flat at the bowler's end as Boland comes running for the second. Steyn collects it on the bounce and whips off the bails. Is Boland out of the crease? The run out decision is referred upstairs and the home side senses a victory. The replays show that Boland is quite short of his crease. A huge cheer from the crowd as it is ruled OUT on the big screen. The players are overwhelmed and come together to celebrate. It has been an incredible show by the home side in this series. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 31 RUNS!
Third umpire is referred for a run out appeal!
Wide! Slower ball and on a length outside off, Zampa lets it go and it is signaled wide by the umpire.
On a length outside leg, Boland was already across his leg stick as he hits it hard to long on for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, Boland drills it hard to long off for a single.
Zampa backs away and plays it square on the off side for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, Boland drills it down to long on for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Zampa goes for the heave over mid-wicket but edges it towards third man for a single.

Oh! That must have hurt! Boland drives it towards mid off and sets off for a quick single. The throw is at the bowler's end and the ball strikes on the groin, just below the danger area. The Aussie dressing room has a hard laugh about it.

OUT! IMRAN TAHIR HAS DONE IT! Warner is run out and perhaps that would be curtains for the Aussies! Change of pace this time, bowls it fullish on middle and leg, Warner backs away and hits it over the covers. Comes through for a quick single and wants the second. Zampa responds. Tahir at deep cover covers good ground and hurls an accurate throw to de Kock who flicks the bails in a jiffy. The onfield umpire rules it out and the replays confirm that he was way out of his crease. Tahir goes up to congratulate Warner too.
Andile Phehlukwayo is back on.
The batsman has slashed hard through the point region. Two runs added to the total.
On a length around off, Zampa is beaten again as the ball zips through to the keeper between his bat and pad.
Good length ball on off, Zampa goes for a slog but misses it completely. A dot ball is worth gold at the moment.
Back of a length outside off, Warner punches it hard towards covers where it is nicely stopped.
Warner moves across his leg stump again and slashes it over point for a couple.
Full length ball outside off, Warner backs away and manages to get a thick outside edge towards third man for a couple.
Dale Steyn back into the attack.
Fullish delivery, driven firmly towards covers. 16 off that over and Warner is turning it on here!
Wide! Going down leg, left alone by Zampa.
Low full toss, clipped towards mid wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done as he saw there was no one in the deep square of the wicket! Straying on the pads, Warned works it behind square leg and the ball races to the fence.
The batsman has played it towards mid wicket. Two runs added to the total.

FOUR! He is maneuvering the field to perfection! Anticipates a short ball and walks across his leg stump. Rabada follows him with a short delivery, he upper cuts it over short third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Beautifully done! Hurls in a full length delivery at the stumps from around the wicket, Warner comes forward and creams it through the covers for an exquisite boundary!
Warner drives this one through mid on for a single.
On a length on off, comes in a touch, Zampa turns it towards mid on for a single to get off the mark.
Good length outside off, played towards point for a single by Warner.
ADAM ZAMPA is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! OUTSTANDING WORK! Good length ball from Abbott that is tucked towards mid-wicket by Tremain.  Warner wants the single and is already long way close. Andile collects and tries to run out Tremain at the non-striker's end but misses. Faf is backing up and he collects the ball and breaks the stumps down with a dive to run out Tremain. Superb work from the skipper!
On a good length outside off, Tremain lets it go through.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Warner gets an inside edge that falls inches away from the stumps. 150 up for DAVID WARNER! His third score of over 150!
Bowls it very full, almost a yorker outside off. Tremain is alert to it and digs it out.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Fullish outside off, Warner commits to the drive with an angled blade and gets it past point for a superb boundary.
Wide! Wayward stuff as he sprays it down leg again. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side. Warner still goes after it but fails to connect.
FOUR! Crafty from Warner! He makes room and cuts it behind point and the ball races towards the fence. Tahir comes running in from deep point and dives but fails to save the boundary.
CHRIS TREMAIN is the new man in for Australia. He needs to stay there with Warner.

OUT! Rabada gets his second and Aussies are slipping into a hole! On a length around off, Mennie comes forward and only manages to lob it uppishly towards mid off. Miller doesn't have to move an inch and grabs an easy catch. The Proteas are jubilant and they sense a victory. Only Warner is standing on their way now!
Length ball outside off, Warner goes inside out towards deep cover for a single.
RABADA back on to bowl.
Fullish ball on middle and leg, Mennie looks to flick but gets an inside edge on to his pads.
JOE MENNIE walks in to bat.

OUT! Abott strikes again! Back of a length ball outside off, Wade has a wild heave at it and looks to go aerial over mid-wicket but only manages to get a faint edge through to de Kock who makes no mistake and pouches it safely. Warner is running short of partners at the end.
Yorker outside off, squeezed towards point for a single.
Similar length delivery outside off, Wade plays it through the point region for a single.
Back of a length ball, dabbed behind point for a single.
FOUR! Fullish ball outside off, Warner drives hard but get a thick outside edge and the ball flies to the third man boundary.
Warner has a shoulder around Tahir after the end of the over and they walk off smiling. That's how one would want these chirps to end.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. The batsmen have run through for a single. 87 needed of 48 balls.
Lands it on a length around leg stump, Wade sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
A tad short, Warner rocks back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Low full toss outside off, driven down to long off for a single.

Wade premeditates on this ocassion, gets a full toss and paddles it round the corner towards du Plessis at short fine leg who dives and fumbles. Has a laught about it as he rolls on to the ground. Single taken by the batsmen.
On the pads, nudged through square leg for a single.
Very full outside off. Warner digs it out uppishly towards covers.
On the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Back of a length outside off, Wade steers it down to third man for a single.
On a length angling across Warner. He cuts it towards point and the fielder there dives and saves a certain boundary. Single taken by the batsmen.
MATTHEW WADE is the new man in.

OUT! The bowling change does the trick and Head goes back to the hut! On a length around off, Head looks to heave it over mid-wicket but gets a top edge that balloons high in the sky behind the keeper. de Kock circles under it and grabs a good catch. Crucial partnership of 90 off 77 balls is broken. Tahir is elated as he hugs De Kock.
Kyle Abbott is brought back on to bowl.
More war of words on the cards. Hastings comes on with the drinks and he too has a word or two to say to Tahir. Tahir does not like it. The umpire has to intervene again.
Pushed through covers for a couple of runs by Warner. There was a misfield on the last ball which allowed the second.
Beaten! A quicker one outside off, Warner is beaten on his drive.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Warner gives himself room and crashes it past mid off. Duminy tries to stop it at deep extra cover but ends up touching the ropes in his attempt.
Flatter on middle, Head works it through mid-wicket for a single. Warner wanted the second but it was never on.
A touch short on off, Head goes back and defends it back down the wicket.
Floated on off, Warner drives it through covers for a single.
Good ball! Angles in a good length ball outside off, Head plays at it from his crease but cannot put bat to ball. Good end to the over from Steyn. 107 needed in 66 balls!
Full again outside off, Head punches it on the up through mid off. The fielder, Rilee stops the ball and  parries it towards long on. That allows the second.
Fuller length outside off, Head looks to chop it away but is beaten.
Steyn goes round the wicket.
Drifts it on the pads, Head misses out on a boundary as he flicks it to the fielder at short fine.
FOUR! Top shot! A length ball from Steyn, Head picks it early and pummels it over mid-wicket for a boundary. That was a clean hit and should put pressure on the bowler.
Fuller length on middle and leg, Warner plays it down the ground for a single.
Tossed up outside off, driven through the covers.
Some heated words being exchanged between Tahir and Warner. The umpire has a word with them too. The pressure is building.

A tad short outside off, Warner cuts it nicely towards Phehlukwayo at point who dives and saves three runs for his side. Single taken by the batsmen. There is an argument between Warner and Tahir. Not sure what's that about and the umpire intervenes.
Head drives it against the spin through mid off for a single.
A tad short and wide outside off, cut through covers for a single.

NOT OUT! Slips in a googly this time, Warner goes across his stumps and looks to sweep it fine but is rapped on the pads. There is a huge appeal for LBW but the umpire rules it not out. The Proteas are thinking about the review and decide to take it in the end. It looked quite close to the naked eye. The Hawk Eye shows that the ball pitched outside leg stump, and hence can't be given out. The on-field call stays! Two leg byes taken by the batsmen.
A review against Warner from South Africa!
Tossed up around leg stump, Warner goes for the reverse sweep but fails to connect this time.
Fullish ball directed at the stumps, Head looks to flick but gets an inside edge on to his pads. Good over from Steyn, only gives away 4 runs.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
On a length angling across Warner. He works it towards mid on for a brisk single.
Steyn is stretching out a bit. South Africa will hope he is fit enough to bowl his quota of overs. He is ready to bowl now.
Good fielding by Miller! Full length ball around off, driven sweetly towards short cover where Miller dives to his left and saves a certain boundary. One run taken by the batsmen.
On the pads, Warner nudges it towards Tahir at short fine leg and scampers through for a quick single.
On a length outside off, tapped towards point for a brisk single.
Steyn back on. Faf is mixing his bowlers around now.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Warner plays it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
A tad short again, Warner cuts it towards point. Doesn't take on the fielder.
Quick through the air and on a length just outside off, Head plays a late cut towards short third man for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Good improvisation from Warner! Flighted ball, Warner brings out the fancy reverse sweep and hits it behind point for a boundary.
Faf recalls Imran Tahir to get him a wicket here.
FOUR! Good shot! Full ball on middle and leg, Head clips it through mid-wicket for a superb boundary. Rabada tried to stop the ball at mid on but failed to do so.
On a length on middle, clipped nicely through mid-wicket for a couple.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side, Warner misses the flick.

On a length around leg stump, Head closes his bat face early and gets a leading edge towards short mid-wicket. It was close to the fielder but safe in the end!
Full ball on middle, Warner drives it towards mid off and scurries through for a single.
Fullish ball around middle and leg, tucked through square leg for a single.

Short of a length ball outside off, Warner stays back and flat bats it over mid off but doesn't get hold of it completely. Good running between the batsmen to come back for three.
Back of a length ball outside off, Head chops it down to third man for a single.
Fullish on middle and leg, Warner comes forward and defends back towards the bowler.
Short of a length ball angling across Warner. He pulls it to the left of Steyn.
Short of a length around middle and leg, nudged behind square leg for a single.
Good fielding! Full length ball on leg stump, Head flicks it nicely towards du Plessis at mid-wicket who dives to his left and keeps it down to a single.
On a length around leg stump, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Full ball around middle and off, Head looks to whip it away but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Going down leg, Warner misses out on this one and is struck on the thigh pad.
Fullish ball outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
FOUR! Bad delivery and it gets the treatment! Short and wide outside off, Head stays back and cuts it aerially over point for a boundary.
9th ODI ton for DAVID WARNER!
100 up for Warner and it has been a brilliant knock! He needs to carry on. Drives the fullish ball towards mid on for a single and raises his hands towards the sky.
Full length ball outside off, Warner drives it hard but fails to pierce the infield.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full and wide outside off, Head throws the kitchen sink at it but fails to connect.
DALE STEYN returns for a spell. Faf ringing in the changes here.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Warner! Going down leg, Warner tucks it round the corner and the ball races to the fence. He becomes the leading run scorer in the series.
on a length on middle and off, Warner stays back and defends.
FOUR! Short ball on leg stump, Warner pulls it and does well to beat the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Fullish in length around leg stump, Head looks to clip but is rapped on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but in vain! The replays show that there was an inside edge.
Short of a length ball on middle and leg, Head camps back and defends.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes back on to bowl. South Africa will know they need to dismiss Warner here.

FOUR! Runs flowing from Warner's bat! Back of a length ball angling across, Warner waits for it and cuts it hard through point. Duminy runs to his right and puts in a dive but fails to save the boundary.
Fuller length outside off, driven hard towards mid off. The fielder does well to save it.
FOUR! Placed it to perfection! On a length angling across, Warner hangs back and glides it behind point for a superb boundary.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. One run added to the total.
On a good length angling across Head. He looks to defend but is beaten.
First slip in place now for Rabada.
On a good length around off, Head gets a bit squared up and feels for it but is beaten all ends up.
Head drives it with the spin through mid off for a single.
A tad short, spinning away. Warner rocks back and cuts it towards extra cover where the fielder dives and takes the pace off the ball. Single taken by the batsmen.
FOUR! Good shot! A touch full and wide outside off, Warner goes inside out and the ball races to the deep cover fence.
Tossed up delivery around middle, Head prods forward and drives it down the ground for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up outside off, Warner drives it nicely through the covers for a single.
JP Duminy brought into the attack.
FOUR! Nicely done! Fullish ball directed at the stumps, Head clips it through mid-wicket for a superb boundary.
Back of a length ball around middle and leg, Head hops back and defends.
On a length angling across, Head plays it towards point where Duminy makes a good stop and saves three runs for his side.
Short ball directed at head, He looks to fend it off but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.

OUT! Marsh plays a loose shot and has to pay the price for it! All the four batsmen have been bowled today. On a length angling into Marsh. He extends his arms and looks to heave it over mid-wicket but misses it completely and the ball disturbs the woodwork.
On a length angling into Marsh. He covers the line well and defends solidly.
This one is tucked through the square leg region for a couple of runs.
BEATEN! A good length ball going across Warner who plays and misses at it.
Square driven through the off side for a single.
A nothing shot, a length ball to which Marsh aims a poke to defend but is beaten.
FOUR! SPANKED! Shorter length on the stumps, attempted slower one, Marsh picks the bones out of that one and sends it packing over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length ball which is guided down to third man for a single. Steyn fields the ball. He is back on the field.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fullish ball outside off, driven towards mid off.
SIX! What a shot! Short ball on middle and leg, Marsh swivels across and pulls it powerfully towards fine leg and the ball sails over the boundary.
Shortish ball on off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single. The 50-run stand is up for the duo.

Marsh survives again! On a length outside off, tapped with soft hands towards point. Marsh sets off for the single and Warner responds. Duminy is quick across the turf to reach the ball and hurls in a throw at the bowler's end and misses the target. Marsh was a goner if that hit!

SIX! Abott drops a catch at the fine leg fence and helps it all the way! Short delivery directed at Marsh, climbing up on him. He rides the bounce and pulls it towards fine leg. Abott misjudged it as he came in a bit and looks to adjust at the last moment. He jumps and the ball pops out of hand and over the boundary.
KAGISO RABADA back on.
Back of a length ball outside off, tapped through point for a single.
On a length around off, Marsh stays back and punches it towards covers.
Good length ball aroud off, punched towards the covers.
On a length outside off, cut behind point for a single.
Fullish ball at the stumps, clipped towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! That's whacked! Back of a length ball directed at the stumps, Warner stays tall and muscles it aerially through mid-wicket and the ball rockets to the fence.
Abbott comes back on for a bowl.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A tad short outside off, Marsh punches it through the covers for a single.
Tossed up on off, Marsh shapes up for the drive but gets it from the inner half of his bat towards wide mid on.
Tossed up around off, spinning in. Warner flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Fullish ball around middle, Marsh drvies it back towards the bowler.
Straying on the pads again, flicked behind square leg for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
An off cutter on the pads this time, Warner tucks it to the short fine leg fielder for a single.
Steyn is off the field and getting some treatment on his right shoulder.
FOUR! Poor bowling from Andile as the fine leg was up inside the circle! Straying on the hips, Warner just tickles it round the corner and beats the short fine leg for a boundary.
Full outside off, driven beautifully through the covers for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! On a length outside off, Marsh punches it through the point region and the ball races to the fence. 100 up for Australia.
Wide! Short ball that is misdirected down leg. Marsh leaves it alone.
Lands it on a length, spinning in. Warner defends it from the crease.
Flighted ball, Warner prods forward and blocks.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Picks up the googly early as he makes room and goes inside out and finds the gap in the deep cover region for a superb boundary.
Full around leg stump, eased through mid on for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Flighted ball on middle and off, Warner strides forward in defence.
Leg bye! Straying on the pads, Warner misses the flick and the ball kisses his pads and goes through to the leg side for a leg bye.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Warner clips it towards short mid-wicket where Miller dives athletically to his right to make a good save.
Back of a length ball around off, Marsh drags his pull shot down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller length ball around leg stump, Warner helps it towards fine leg for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Marsh pushes it through the covers for a single.
On a length angling across Warner. He stays back and punches it towards covers for a single.
Flighted ball around off, Warner comes forward and drives it through extra cover for a single.
Full ball outside off, Marsh hits it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up around off, spinning away. Marsh pushes it towards covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Warner drives the tossed up ball through mid off for a single.
Quicker through the air on middle, Warner stays back and defends.
Fullish ball around off, driven back towards the bowler.
Fuller in length on off, Marsh stays back and defends.
Good length ball around off, Marsh camps back and punches it towards the cover region
Straying on the pads, tucked nicely round the corner for a couple.
Dug in short, Warner pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. They pick up a single.

Similar delivery, Warner attempts the drive but is beaten all ends up.

Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Loopy ball spinning in, Warner pushes it towards point and sets off for a run. The throw at the bowler's end is way wide and Marsh is home safely.

On a length outside off, Marsh plays it towards point.

Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Tossed up on middle, Bailey strides forward and defends.
Fuller length ball outside off, pushed back towards the bowler.

OUT! Tahir does the damage and the skipper falls! Pushed quicker through the air and fullish on off, Smith with his feet planted on the crease looks to drive on the up but is no way close to the ball and the ball disturbs the woodwork. Tahir is overjoyed as he runs towards the crowd and celebrates! What an over, the game has turned on its head.

OUT! Beautiful ball and Finch departs! Slips in the flipper this time and pushed quicker through the air, Finch looks to give himself room to cut but misses it completely and the ball crashes into the stumps. South Africa strike!

A loud LBW appeal turned down! Tossed up around middle an leg, Finch goes for the sweep but misses and is rapped low on the pads. There is a huge appeal for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show there was an inside edge.
Pushed quick through the air and full on leg stump, Finch defends it towards short mid-wicket.

That one missed by a whisker! Fullish delivery outside off. swinging in. Finch looks to go down the ground but is beaten by the extra swing and the ball zips past the stumps and goes through to the keeper.

The replays spot an inside edge on to the pads but the umpire didn't pick it up as he signals it as a leg bye.
Fullish ball around middle, Warner strides forward and defends confidently.
On a length around off, Finch plays it with soft hands towards covers for a brisk single.
Fullish delivery directed at the stumps, Warner takes a couple of steps down the track and drags it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Finch plays it towards point.
On a length outside off, pushed towards the point region on the back foot.
Good length ball on leg stump, clipped towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! On a length and a bit wide outside off, Finch stays back and powers it through the covers and the ball races to the fence.
FOUR! Similar delivery and Finch doesn't miss out this time! Finch stands tall and punches it elegantly wide of mid off for a superb boundary.
On a length just outside off, Finch punches it towards covers but fails to peirce the gap.
Abbott comes back on for a bowl.
A tad short on off, Warner pushes it towards point off his crease.
Fuller outside off, Warner pushes it towards the off side but not for any runs.
Good length on off, punched towards mid on for a single by Finch.
Back of a length outside off, Finch gets on his toes and defends it.
Fuller on the pads though, Warner works it to square leg for a single.
Fuller length on middle, Warner defends it back to the bowler.
On a length on off, Finch stays back and defends.
Low full toss outside off, Warner squeezes it towards third man for a single. Couldn't capitalize on the free hit.

FOUR! Easy pickings for Warner! Straying on the pads, Warner helps it down to the fine leg region for a boundary. Rabada overstepped on that occasion and it is signalled as a no ball. Free hit coming up.
That is brilliant bowling from Rabada! Back of a length ball, angling into Warner. He is surprised by a bit of extra bounce as he fends it off towards point.
The batsman plays the Square Cut. They manage to come back for the second.
FOUR! Sloppy work in the field! Shortish and wide outside off, Warner punches it towards Phehlukwayo at extra cover who fumbles allowing the ball to go through and it zips through to the boundary.
FOUR! Fullish ball around off, Warner gives it the full swing of the bat but drags it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Straying on the pads, Warner helps it to the leg side for a single.
On a length around middle, Warner defends it from the inner half of his bat.
FOUR! Warner is looking dangerous out there! On a length outside off, Warner makes a bit of room and lofts it over mid on for a superb boundary.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Short ball around middle, Warner stays tall and hits it over mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! That's muscled! A tad short outside off, Warner rocks back and pulls it powerfully through the mid-wicket region for a cracking boundary.
DALE STEYN comes into the attack.
Good length ball around off, defended off the back foot.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.

Dropped! Warner nearly guides it into the hand of Amla at first slip but de Kock intervenes and spills it! Back of a length ball outside off, Warner looks to run it down to third man but only manages to glide it towards first slip. de Kock dives full length to his left but isn't able to hold on to the catch. That can be a crucial miss!
Loose from Warner! Back of a length ball angling across Warner. He pushes at it hard but gets beaten.
Good length ball on middle, Warner stays back and defends.
Full delivery directed at the stumps, Warner makes room and glides it behind backward point for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Similar delivery, Finch pushes at it tamely and gets beaten.
That's a jaffa! On a length outside off, swinging away. Finch has no choice but to play at it and is beaten comprehensively.
That was a close shave for Finch! Fuller length ball around off, shaping in. Finch looks to push at it but gets an inside edge onto his body.
On a length angling into Finch. He stays back and defends it towards the leg side.
Shortish delivery around leg, Warner pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Shortish ball around off, Finch camps back and pushes it towards the covers.
Full length ball outside off, Warner plays it with an angled blade behind point for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length ball on off, pushed towards covers off his back foot.
FOUR! Powerful from Warner! Short outside off, Warner stands tall and pulls it over square leg and the ball races to the fence.
On a length around leg stump, Warner fails to flick it and is struck on the thigh pad.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
That's a peach of a delivery! On a good length outside off, swinging away. Finch is drawn forward and pushes at it tamely but gets beaten all ends up.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Similar length outside off, Finch doesn't misses out this time as he punches it beautifully through the covers for a superb boundary.
Short and wide outside off, Finch cuts it fiercely to the fielder at point but fails to find the gap.
On a length outside off, Finch camps back and plays it with soft hands towards mid on.
Full delivery outside off, Finch takes the aerial route and plays the drive on the up. He doesn't get it from the meat of his bat and the ball falls towards deep cover safely and they run a couple.
Pacy and full ball outside off, Warner drives it sweetly to mid off.
On a length on off, Warner defends it towards the covers.
Short and wide outside off, Warner stays back and cuts it towards point where Duminy dives and takes the pace off the ball yet they take a couple of runs.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
On a good length on middle and off, Finch lunges forward and defends. He is not offering any room to Finch to work with.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side, Finch still looks to flick it but misses.
Short delivery directed at the rib cage, Warner tucks it through square leg for a single.
Kagiso Rabada is the bowler from the other end.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery as Finch shoulders his arms yet again.
Fullish and pacy delivery outside off, Finch leaves it alone.

A loud shout for LBW turned down! In the corridor of uncertainty outside off, nipping in. Finch is cramped for room as he looks to defend but misses the line completely and is struck high on the pad. There is a loud shout for LBW but in vain! It looked like the impact was just outside off and a bit high as well. Hawk Eye confirms the same.
On a length outside off, Finch covers the line well and defends solidly.
Good length outside off, swinging in a bit. Finch is watchful as he lets it go through to the keeper.
Leg bye. On a length around leg stump, comes in a bit. Warner looks to flick but misses and is struck on the thigh pad. The ball rolls towards the keeper for a leg bye.

The players are out in the middle. David Warner and Aaron Finch will open the batting for Australia. It promises to be a cracking contest between bat and ball. Kyle Abott to begin the proceedings for the Proteas.
